sources.text: In this fictional training case: Clicking began immediately after swapping the lightweight training tray. I noticed rhythmic click near the tray guide. My working interpretation was: The guide may be contacting the new tray. My decision was: Inspect the tray guide before assuming motor failure. Why: The symptom began with a tray change; location and timing favor guide contact. Exception: If there was no tray change or the sound location is unknown, do not assume this cause. Outcome: The clicking stopped in the simulated replay after the guide was reset. Training simulation only; prop stopped and deenergized; trainer present. If context differs or an active equipment hazard is reported, stop and escalate to the site authorized person. Confirm the asset and symptom in the training scenario. Establish whether this reviewed case matches. Record the trainer confirmed simulation outcome. Separate observed results from assumptions.

My decision was: Compare the setup to the approved training reference. Why: The reference exposes setup changes without guessing a component fault. Exception: If reference configuration is unavailable, stop and ask the trainer. Outcome: Trainer demonstrated a corrected setup in simulation. Training simulation only; prop stopped and deenergized; trainer present. If context differs or an active equipment hazard is reported, stop and escalate to the site authorized person. Confirm the asset and symptom in the training scenario. Establish whether this reviewed case matches. Record the trainer confirmed simulation outcome. Separate observed results from assumptions.

In this fictional training case: Lightweight training trays stop at the same guide. I noticed jams recur at one marked point. My working interpretation was: A guide obstruction may be present. My decision was: Review the marked guide area on the stopped prop. Why: Repeated location is more informative than the generic symptom of a stopped belt. Exception: If stops occur at different points, this case does not establish the cause. Outcome: A paper obstruction was found on the training prop.
